facts.text: Aurelle Residence is developed by Halden Properties.
Located in Al Furjan, Dubai, a connected community between Dubai Marina and Al Maktoum International Airport, with parks, schools and everyday conveniences.
About 5 minutes to Al Furjan Metro.
About 12 minutes to Ibn Battuta Mall.
About 25 minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport.
Sixteen residential levels with 76 residences in total.
Five residence types: 1 BHK, 1 BHK + Study, 2 BHK + Maid Room on levels 1 to 14 and on the penthouse floors, and 3 BHK and 4 BHK penthouses with private jacuzzi on levels 15 and 16.
Each typical floor (levels 1 to 14) has five homes: two corner 2 BHK + Maid Room units (A and E), two 1 BHK + Study units (B and D) and one central 1 BHK (C).
Penthouse floors (levels 15 and 16) have three homes: a 4 BHK penthouse with jacuzzi (P1), a 2 BHK + Maid Room (P2) and a 3 BHK penthouse with jacuzzi (P3).
Italian finishes throughout, including Italian kitchen cabinetry with a stone island.
A single-panel smart home system controls the home.
Open layouts with floor-to-ceiling glass in the living areas; bathrooms in stone and oak with a freestanding tub.

Twelve amenities on the landscaped podium, a lift ride from every home: Zen Garden, Yoga Studio, gym, walking track, adults swimming pool, steam room and lockers, social terrace, jacuzzi, adults outdoor gym, kids play area, padel court and a cricket simulator.
The sales gallery is in Al Furjan and is open daily from 10:00 to 19:00. Private site visits and video calls can be booked here in the chat.
Images and films on the website are AI-generated artist impressions for illustration only; plans, areas and availability are indicative and subject to change.
Unit sizes range from about 673 sq ft (1 BHK) to about 3,356 sq ft (4 BHK penthouse) including balcony; exact areas per unit come from the unit lookup.
